title: AdoptionWorkflowInput
description: Issue #285: input to the short-lived AdoptionWorkflow started by api-gateway POST /positions/adopt. Identifies the confirmed orphan (tenant, strategy, occ) to adopt and the operator who triggered it (provenance / audit). The workflow resolves broker_target from StrategyConfig to route its broker-truth ReconciliationExecActivity calls to the correct exec task queue (broker-<broker_target>); it is not an input field.

occ.description: The orphaned OCC option symbol to adopt. Operator may supply the broker/audit compact form or the padded OccSymbol.of form; the workflow resolves the canonical padded form from the journal anchor.

operator_id.description: Operator who triggered the adoption (from X-Operator-Id). Recorded in the PositionAdopted audit provenance.

allow_unrecorded.description: Operator-only (the /live Adopt button). When true and no journal row anchors the OCC (a lot bought outside the system, e.g. directly at the broker), adopt it anyway under a synthesized entry_signal_id ('adopt:<run id>') with qty and entry premium from broker truth, after refusing when any running PositionWorkflow already owns the OCC for this tenant or on this broker account. Absent/false keeps the original REFUSED_NO_ANCHOR behavior; recon auto-adoption never sets it.
